io_mapping._comment_horn: Horn on DO 15: ON while AUTO is RUNNING. HORN_MODE "running" = the whole time in RUNNING (also while stopped at a station); "moving" = only while driving. -1 = no horn.

hardware._comment_cal: 2026-10-26 REMAP: on the floor the AGV drove at HALF the commanded speed (1 m/s set = 0.5 m/s real), so every value here was halved (matches the old fit 646.59/-101.2). The 2026-05-30 encoder run over-read speed 2x - check encoder COUNTS_PER_REV / WHEEL_DIAMETER_M before running the wheel calibration again. Previous note: Per-wheel motor cal from encoder run 2026-05-30 (rpm=RPM_PER_VOLT*V+OFFSET, R2=0.99 for V>=0.55). Old single fit 646.59/-101.2 was ~2x too low. Shared keys kept as fallback.

speeds._comment_trim: MANUAL_TRIM_PCT: koreksi jalan lurus di MANUAL (%). Positif = roda kiri diperlambat / kanan dipercepat -> AGV belok kiri (untuk AGV yang condong ke kanan). Negatif = sebaliknya. Bisa diubah live di PARAMS > LIVE TUNING.
speeds._comment_ramps: AUTO ramps in real m/s² (2026-10-27 fix: before, each ~10 Hz sensor frame stepped as if 10 ms had passed, so every ramp ran 10x slower than set; values divided by 10 = same behaviour). ACCEL_RATE is used toward SLOW / APPROACH; ACCEL_RATE_MEDIUM / _HIGH / _MAX toward those modes.

pid_tuning._comment_high: HIGH gains — retuned for 0.6 m/s (was 0.32 m/s: KP=2.8, TD=0.26, V_RED_COEF=2.8, clamp=1000). Start point only — verify on the physical track and adjust.
pid_tuning._comment_medium_max: MEDIUM (0.5 m/s) and MAX (1.0 m/s) gains — start = copy of the HIGH gains; tune with PARAMS > PID AUTO-TUNE.
pid_tuning._comment_approach: APPROACH gains — 0.2 m/s station crawl. The approach is guided by a one-sided physical bar on the AGV's RIGHT; tape is straight here so the PID needs little authority. Asymmetric clamp: INTO_BAR (positive output = yaw right into the bar) held tight at 8 rpm so the bar centers the AGV mechanically instead of the PID over-pressing the bearings; AWAY (off the bar) kept at 80 rpm for recovery. INTO_BAR is the tuning dial — lower toward 0 if it still binds, raise if it drifts left off the bar.
pid_tuning._comment_shared: Shared — integral and timing constants. TI/deadband lowered to null corner standing bias faster at higher speed.
pid_tuning._comment_sr: Speed reduction coefficients — split by speed mode

can_sensor._comment_floor_spots: Floor magnetic disturbances. A: left/right track more than TRACK_SPREAD_MM apart outside a fork area -> follow the track nearest the last reading (fork area = from a set_track tag / K-L key until the tracks are back together FORK_SETTLE_S, max FORK_ZONE_MAX_S). B (spot shifts the reading): put an RFID tag just before it with action {"type": "sensor_hold", "distance_m": 0.5} - the AGV crosses that distance with the steering held and the sensor ignored (max SENSOR_HOLD_MAX_M).

encoder._comment: CANopen friction-wheel encoder for wheel-speed calibration. Multi-turn: TPDO1 maps 0x6004 (24-bit), wraps at TOTAL_RANGE not per-rev. WHEEL_DIAMETER_M is the encoder friction wheel contact diameter; v_ground = omega_enc * (WHEEL_DIAMETER_M/2).

calibration._comment: Open-loop straight ramp for input-vs-actual wheel speed. Shortened ramp (0->0.5 m/s, 2s dwell) to fit ~13 m of straight track.

feedforward._comment_2026_10_27: Run logs: the route's curves are about 3.5 m radius (was 1.5 m for the old stadium) and there are LEFT and RIGHT curves. A set_speed SLOW action can say "corner": "left" / "right" (and "radius_m"); true uses CURVE_DIRECTION / CURVE_RADIUS_M below; false = no feedforward.
feedforward._comment: Curvature feedforward for corners: output_ff = FF_SCALE*sign*0.5*base_rpm*(TRACK_WIDTH_M/CURVE_RADIUS_M), applied while speed_mode is a curve mode. Stadium is CCW => all left turns. FF_SCALE=0.5 halves the compensation (2026-05-30).

sequences._comment: Slow down zone — RFID-only trigger. Tag 0014 is used before BOTH left and right curves (run logs 2026-10-27), so no curve feedforward here ("corner": false) — the PID steers the curve. For feedforward, give right-curve tags their own ID with "corner": "right" and left-curve tags "corner": "left".
sequences.name: speed_zone_slow

sequences._comment: Floor-spot zone START (placeholder tag 00D1 - replace with the real tag). From here the AGV drives straight WITHOUT the magnetic sensor (keeps the steering it had over the last ~1 s) until the straight_end tag; max STRAIGHT_ZONE_MAX_M (can_sensor) if the END tag is missed. Put it on a STRAIGHT, at least 1 m after a curve. Add {"type": "set_speed", "speed": "SLOW", "corner": false} before it to cross slowly.
sequences.name: straight_zone_start

sequences._comment: Floor-spot zone END (placeholder tag 00D2 - replace with the real tag): magnetic sensor back on.

sequences._comment: Add-on to the RFID tags: MGS1600 LEFT and RIGHT marker seen AT THE SAME TIME (opposite-polarity tape on both sides of the track) -> HIGH to MEDIUM. Only acts when the AGV is at HIGH (requires_speed); at any other speed, and with one marker alone, nothing happens. Fires once per marker pair (cooldown 3 s; the sensor reports markers every frame while they are under it). Not while a trolley-station approach is armed.
sequences.name: marker_both_medium

sequences._comment: HOMEPOST (tag 0000): brake and end AUTO there (back to ARMED, run log saved); START / G starts the next trip. Ignored for the first 5 s after START (the AGV may start on this tag). Put a SLOW tag (e.g. 0014) before it so it arrives slowly.
sequences.name: homepost_stop

features._comment: RFID split into NAV (corner speed zones) -> SEQ (stops/PLC handshakes) -> SLMP. Hierarchy: disabling a parent disables its children.

watchdog._comment: Safety watchdog timeouts for hardware driver health checks

timing._comment: Hardware poll intervals (seconds). DI at 100 Hz so the prox station marker is fresher for precise stops.

rotate._comment: Putar 180° di atas pita magnet (sama dengan AGV Kayaba). Tombol T = kiri (CCW), Y = kanan (CW), atau tombol ROTATE 180° di halaman MANUAL (mode MANUAL/ARMED); tekan T/Y lagi untuk berhenti. Berputar SPEED_MPS, melambat ke CREEP_MPS saat sensor depan menemukan pita lagi, rem saat |posisi| <= CENTER_TOL_MM. Gunakan di pita lurus, jauh dari percabangan/tag.

keypad._comment: Keypad USB (dongle) di PC AGV, mapping sama dengan AGV Kayaba. WASD/panah = gerak (tahan, hanya MANUAL), 1-5 = speed AUTO APPROACH/SLOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/MAX, Q = ganti MANUAL/AUTO, K/L = track kiri/kanan, E = EMERGENCY STOP (lepas dengan RESET), ENTER = RESET, G = START AUTO (hanya dari ARMED, harus ada tape). PLC trolley (tahan, hanya MANUAL, SLMP harus aktif): Z = pusher EXTEND, X = pusher RETRACT, U/I/O = conveyor atas FWD/RVS/CLR ERR, B/N/M = conveyor bawah FWD/RVS/CLR ERR. R (reverse) tidak ada di AGV ini. T = putar 180° kiri, Y = putar 180° kanan. cabang (7/8/9/0) tidak dipakai di keypad, pilih di HMI. NAME_CONTAINS kosong = semua keyboard USB dipakai; isi dengan sebagian nama keypad (lihat: python3 debugging/list_keypads.py) supaya hanya keypad itu yang dipakai. GRAB true = tombol tidak masuk ke desktop/terminal PC AGV.
